items.pregunta: How much do Aikido classes at Dojo da Luz cost?
items.respuesta: The standard fee at Dojo da Luz is €35 per month for up to three classes a week. Children pay €25 per month for one weekly class and €35 for two. A reduced fee of €30 is available for students and unemployed people, on proof.

items.pregunta: Do I need previous experience to start practising Aikido?
items.respuesta: No previous experience is needed to start practising Aikido at Dojo da Luz. You can book a trial class, which costs €5 and is deducted from your first monthly fee.

items.pregunta: Where are the dojos in Lisbon?
items.respuesta: Dojo da Luz teaches in three locations in Lisbon: Benfica, Lumiar and Encarnação. In Lumiar, practice takes place at the Pista de Atletismo Municipal Prof. Moniz Pereira.

items.pregunta: From what age can children practise?
items.respuesta: Children's and teenagers' classes at Dojo da Luz are for ages 5 to 17: in Benfica from Monday to Friday, 18:30 to 19:30, and in Encarnação on Tuesdays and Thursdays, 17:30 to 18:30.

items.pregunta: When can I enrol in the classes?
items.respuesta: Enrolment at Dojo da Luz is open at any time of the year. The 2026–2027 season runs from September to June; in July and August a reduced timetable is published in June.
Buki Waza is Aikido practice with wooden weapons: the Ken, a wooden sword, and the Jo, a staff about 1.27 m long. Dojo da Luz holds a Buki Waza class in Lumiar on Saturdays, 11:00 to 12:30.
